Users can also define the [README\.md?plain=1 L334](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/afdb/README.md?plain=1#L334) for multiple copies of the protein chain, indicate whether to [README\.md?plain=1 L70](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L70), and set a [README\.md?plain=1 L70](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L70) \(an ISO 8601 date string\) to filter PDB templates\. Additionally, [README\.md?plain=1 L111](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L111) can be provided in A3M format for multiple sequence alignment, and custom structural [README\.md?plain=1 L133](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/README.md?plain=1#L133) can be included as a list of dictionaries containing [README\.md?plain=1 L160](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/README.md?plain=1#L160) content, [README\.md?plain=1 L122](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L122), and [README\.md?plain=1 L124](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L124) for residue mapping\.

 Single\-stranded [README\.md?plain=1 L53](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L53) and [README\.md?plain=1 L54](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L54) entities require specifying their respective [pipeline\_multimer\.py L41](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/alphafold/data/pipeline_multimer.py#L41) \(A, T, G, C for DNA; A, U, G, C for RNA\) and [README\.md?plain=1 L334](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/afdb/README.md?plain=1#L334) for copies\. Both can include optional [LICENSE L27](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/LICENSE#L27) with a [README\.md?plain=1 L194](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L194) \(using CCD codes\) and [README\.md?plain=1 L197](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L197)\. Double\-stranded DNA modeling is achieved by providing two [README\.md?plain=1 L53](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L53) entries, one for the forward and one for the reverse complement strand\.

 Finally, [README\.md?plain=1 L55](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L55) and [README\.md?plain=1 L56](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L56) entities are specified by their respective [README\.md?plain=1 L93](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/server/README.md?plain=1#L93) and [README\.md?plain=1 L334](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold/blob/c77e5d2a8961d1a353632c462914ff0a32a950f6/afdb/README.md?plain=1#L334), allowing for the inclusion of small molecules and ions in the modeling process\. These detailed entity\-specific parameters provide granular control over the AlphaFold modeling task, enabling the prediction of complex biological assemblies\. For a general overview of the JSON request schema, refer to [AlphaFold Server JSON Request Schema](https://codewiki.google/github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold#alphafold-server-job-submission-alphafold-server-json-request-schema)\.
